query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Does every Ashcombe listing offer size M? Answer yes or no. By 'offer size M' I mean listings whose size menu includes it, whether or not it is sold out.

The results page lists 15 listings on one page; there is no next page.

Note what the question actually requires, because the two possible answers need very different amounts of work.
To answer No you need exactly ONE listing that lacks the option. One counterexample settles a claim about every listing.
To answer Yes you must have opened every single one.
1. Open every listing on the page before answering, and check each for the option asked about.
2. If one lacks the option, answer No and name that listing as your evidence.
3. Only if you exhaust every enumerated listing without finding one may you answer Yes.
In your answer, say how many listings you opened and which one settled it.

result.final: No. Not every Ashcombe listing offers size M. Ivybridge Uniforms ($18.37, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-15.html) lacks size M entirely — its size dropdown only contains S, L, and XL, with no M option at all.
